proposals.title: Simple Majority Vote
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to replace supermajority voting requirements in the charter and bylaws with a majority of votes cast or simple majority standard.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Lobbying
proposals.proponent: Zevin Asset Management on behalf of Alyson Pyette; co-filers Dana Investment Advisors and Miller/Howard Investments, Inc. on behalf of Owen Harvey
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report on lobbying policies, lobbying and grassroots payments, model-legislation organization memberships, and board oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Patent Process
proposals.proponent: Friends Fiduciary Corporation and co-filers Mercy Investment Services, Inc., Bon Secours Mercy Health, Inc., The Sisters of Charity of Saint Elizabeth, and others
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to establish and report on a process considering the impact of extended patent exclusivities on product access when pursuing secondary and tertiary patents.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
